seo.title: TablePro for teams
seo.description: Share connections and saved queries with your team without their passwords. Priced per seat, monthly or yearly, with an invoice for your company.

header.title: TablePro for teams
header.lead: Share connections and saved queries with your team, without their passwords. Every seat gets Pro, and your company gets an invoice.

share.title: What your team shares
share.lead: Two ways to share, depending on where you want the files to live.

library.title: Team Library
library.text: Owners and admins publish connection settings, saved queries and their folders to TablePro's server. Members with a seat get them in the sidebar, kept up to date, and see who last changed each query.

catalog.title: Team Catalog
catalog.text: Publish password-free connection files to a folder your team already shares, such as a Git repository or a shared drive. Teammates add it as a Linked Folder. Nothing goes through TablePro's server.

pro.title: Pro on every seat
pro.text: Each Mac on the team gets every Pro feature, such as {proExamples}.

seats.title: Seats and members
items: A seat covers one person on up to {deviceLimit} computers, Mac or Linux.
Owners and admins invite people by email from the Members page of your account, with a role and, if they choose, a seat. The link works for 7 days, and any TablePro account can accept it.
The owner handles billing. Admins manage members, invitations, the Team Library and the team's audit log. Members use what is shared.
The owner changes a subscription's seats in Billing, and {merchant} charges or credits the prorated difference at once.
Removing a member frees their seat. Their Macs lose Team's features the next time TablePro checks in.

pricing.title: Price
pricing.note: Team is a subscription; there is no one-time Team license.

buying.title: Buying for a company
items: {merchant} is the merchant of record: it takes the payment and calculates sales tax or VAT from your billing address.
In {merchant}'s customer portal you can add your company's name, VAT number and billing address to each invoice, then download it.
A purchase can be refunded within {refundDays} days, and each renewal within {refundDays} days of its charge.
Need a purchase order, or another way to pay? Write to <email>{email}</email> and we will work it out with you.

data.title: Your team's data
items: Passwords are never sent to TablePro's server. The app removes them before publishing, and the server refuses anything that holds one.
The Team Library keeps connection settings and saved queries on TablePro's server. Only Macs activated on your license can read them.
If the plan ends, what was published stays on the server until the team's owner deletes the team, which deletes the library with it.

enterprise.title: Need more control?
enterprise.text: Sign-in with your company accounts, policies enforced on team connections, an audit of production writes and MDM deployment are built when companies ask for them. Tell us what you need.
